facts.business: SVS Ventures Limited changed its main object from real estate business to agro base business during the year on 05/09/2026.

auditor.name: J M Patel & Bros.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion based on: 1) Investment unrecoverable, related parties loan and advances, stock unverifiable; 2) Partial recovery of Rs. 2.58 crores from Gopnath Developers Pvt Ltd and Rs. 0.69 crore from M/s Sagar Empire Pvt Ltd, but other issues pending; 3) Loan and advances increased by Rs. 3.00 crores; 4) Rs. 6.98 crores outstanding loans in Mr. Shashikant Sharma's account and Rs. 3.49 crores in M/s Vijay & Co. account unrecoverable; 5) Group company transactions of Rs. 5.92 crores net debit subject to verification; 6) Revenue from GST-free agro items without packing weight, trademarks details; 7) Unverifiable/fictitious assets: Goodwill Rs. 2.51 crores, old stock of building material Rs. 3.81 crores; 8) Non-compliance with Section 128(5) - no accounting software with non-disable audit trail.

key_risks: Related parties loan and advances subject to verification
Outstanding loans to former MD Mr. Shashikant Sharma (Rs. 6.98 crores) and his firm M/s Vijay & Co. (Rs. 3.49 crores) unrecoverable
Group company transactions (net debit Rs. 5.92 crores) subject to verification
Revenue from agro items without proper documentation (packing weight, trademarks)
Unverifiable/fictitious assets: Goodwill Rs. 2.51 crores, old stock Rs. 3.81 crores
Non-compliance with accounting software audit trail requirements
Utilization of public issue funds doubtful and suspicious of recovery
No depreciation provided on IPO expense/Goodwill
facts.related_party_note: During the year, group of companies under same management had major business and loan & advance transactions: Loan & Advances – Debit Rs 5.41 crores, Credit Rs. 0.92 crore; Creditors Account – Debit Rs 9.54 crores, Credit Rs 14.61 crores; Debtors Account – Debit Rs 14.10 crores, Credit Rs. 7.60 crores; Net Debit – Rs. 5.92 crores. After resignation of old promoter, the promoter of said group of companies manages the whole business activity. Transactions subject to verification, justification of disbursement and recovery. Related party transactions disclosed in significant accounting policy and notes to account.
